title: Unified Optimization of Traffic Signal and Lane Channelization for an Isolated Intersection Using Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimizing traffic signal control has been a long-lasting critical issue in traffic engineering, and a number of robust methodologies have emerged to solve the problem so far. On the other hand, the road design for lane channelization is a static problem that is difficult to solve jointly with the real-time traffic signal control. If traffic volume does not vary, it is possible that both problems can be solved in an integrated manner as a single static optimization problem. Recently, researchers have devised a mixed integer linear problem (MILP) to jointly determine the traffic signal and road width designs. However, this joint optimization problem must be solved repeatedly whenever the traffic flow pattern varies. Solving the MILP may also take impractical computing time as the problem size gets larger. We present a robust methodology for solving the joint optimization problem using reinforcement learning (RL) on a real-time basis. Abru

translated_title: 基于强化学习的单点交叉口交通信号与车道渠化统一优化
translated_abstract: 优化交通信号控制一直是交通工程中一个长期存在的关键问题，迄今为止已经涌现出许多稳健的方法来解决这一问题。另一方面，车道渠化的道路设计是一个静态问题，难以与实时交通信号控制进行联合求解。如果交通量保持不变，则有可能将这两个问题作为一个单一的静态优化问题进行一体化求解。最近，研究人员设计了一种混合整数线性规划（MILP）来联合确定交通信号和道路宽度设计。然而，每当交通流模式发生变化时，这一联合优化问题都必须重新求解。而且随着问题规模的增大，求解MILP可能需要不切实际的计算时间。我们提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的稳健方法，能够实时求解该联合优化问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的实时联合优化方法，可同时求解单点交叉口的交通信号控制与车道渠化设计，克服了传统混合整数线性规划（MILP）需随交通流模式变化反复求解且大规模问题时计算耗时的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based methodology for real-time joint optimization of traffic signal control and lane channelization at an isolated intersection, overcoming the need to repeatedly solve a computationally expensive MILP whenever traffic flow patterns change.
